tiers.name: Thorp
tiers.blurb: A charter, a wagon and a handful of settlers at the ford.

tiers.name: Hamlet
tiers.blurb: Enough hearths to call it a place. Quarries and sheepfolds can open.

tiers.name: Village
tiers.blurb: A market green and a grain store. The Market and Trades wards can be laid out, weavers and carpenters set up, and cottages grow into timber houses.

tiers.name: Town
tiers.blurb: A chartered market town. The Temple Ward and the riverside open, stone walls can ring the old town, and land can be zoned medium density, where timber houses become stone townhouses.

tiers.name: Large Town
tiers.blurb: Magistrates, guild money and stone walls. Castle Hill and the Field Ward open, vineyards, scriptoria, theatres and libraries follow, and the crowded old town can be zoned high density, where tall houses rise wall to wall.

tiers.name: City
tiers.blurb: A walled city of many faiths and trades. Manors rise on Castle Hill, the outer wards open, and the city can raise a cathedral, an arena and a keep.

tiers.name: Great City
tiers.blurb: A great city whose name is known in every court. Its wealth draws the best heroes and the worst enemies.

wards.name: Old Town
wards.blurb: The charter land around the hall, where the first families built.

wards.name: Market Ward
wards.blurb: Shops and stalls on the road to the river ford. Commercial land here sells dear.

wards.name: Trades Ward
wards.blurb: Workshops, yards and smoke. Cheap land for the crafts.

wards.name: Temple Ward
wards.blurb: Quiet streets around the temples. The only ground holy enough for a cathedral.

wards.name: Castle Hill
wards.blurb: High ground above the ford. Manors and the keep can only rise here, and rents are steep.

wards.name: Riverside
wards.blurb: Wharves and fish sheds on the river bank, outside the walls. Fisheries can only work here.

wards.name: Field Ward
wards.blurb: Old caravan grounds outside the north gate. Cheap, crowded and rowdy; tenements go up here.

wards.name: Southgate
wards.blurb: Caravan yards and coaching inns at the south gate, where the trade roads come in.

wards.name: Tanners' Row
wards.blurb: Downwind and outside the walls: tanneries, dye pits and the poor who work them.

densities.name: Low
densities.blurb: Cottages and timber houses with gardens and lanes between, as in any frontier village.

densities.name: Medium
densities.blurb: Houses may rise to three-storey stone townhouses, and manors on Castle Hill.

densities.name: High
densities.blurb: Tall houses of four and five storeys built wall to wall, the way a walled city's old core packs in. Crowded: residents grumble a little.
